criteria.description: Exactly one centered h1/description, two CTA, one poster trigger/scrim/play and one dialog/loader/iframe; zero forms
Centered copy/actions above one landscape media at mobile and desktop without overflow
Named trigger/title/busy semantics, loading/loaded states and one playable video
Escape, close and backdrop dismiss with trap and focus restoration
Repeated open clears iframe and never duplicates video
No-JS preserves copy, CTAs, poster and real media alternative
Light/dark, reduced motion, focus, 44px and axe WCAG 2.1 AA
